title: pie time
description: this mod adds a new pie item thta can be thrown to stick you enemies to the ground and blind them
body:
PIE TIME

this is a mod that adds pie to the game but no in the normal way you cant realy eat the pie it has a diffrent use which is throwing it!
you can throw the pie at your enemies to stick them to the ground


functionality

you can chrge the pie like a bow than launch it if it hits a mob it makes them unable to move but if it hits a player it does tha same thing but also adds some jam to there screen thta can blind them a bit.

if it hits a block it places a pie block which you can right click to gain regnartion.
you can also break the block to get it and use it as decoraiton or just to have it on you for emergancy.

CRAFTING

to craft the pie you first need to get a diffrent item witch is jam , you can get the a glass of jam with sweet berries suger and glass.

the jar can be placed for deocraiton.

to craft the pie you need 4 wheat 1 egg and 1 jam jar.
